The original `public-0.571.0.json` contains 40 complete published API results
with source maps requested and disabled. Both registry archive SRIs and the
exact installed JavaScript and native image bytes were verified before capture.
Those original bytes remain unchanged. The supplemental file adds two actual
parse-error neighbors; the incomplete declaration in the original `invalid`
case is tolerated by the existing backend and retains its successful recovery.

The source native witness retains all 84 real calls before comparing complete
results. `tests/_fixtures/differential/compiler/css-source-map-10693` pins the
actual primary CSS, options, whole missing-map result, independently authored
whole repaired result and exact original/repaired producer hashes. Its expected
UTF16 rule coordinates also have literal decoded Rust assertions. It lives in
`cssApiCases`, outside the SSR execution and whole-product native denominators.

Maps are qualified only when existing preprocessing preserves the actual input
bytes and there is no embedded input map. Transformed scoped/v-bind inputs,
embedded maps and empty/error results remain explicitly unqualified. The shared
backend records actual rule origins during its existing parse/print; no second
CSS parse or host-side inferred map is used.

The optional Actions measurement uses pristine, separate optimized base/head
targets, image tokens and hashes, ABBA process order, full result packets and
every map-off/on timing sample. These are report-only source measurements and
do not establish an instruction ceiling or universal performance claim.
